block.refinedstorage.security_manager.he: Locks down your whole system the moment it's placed: nobody can do anything until they have a Ward Bypass in it. Bind and configure your own Ward Bypass before you place this!
gui.refinedstorage.storage.redstone_mode: When this block is inactive, whatever it holds can't be reached from your system.
gui.refinedstorage.grid.inaccurate_extra: Due to a bug in %s the wrong resource may have been extracted. The resource might stick around in the Console, only visually, until you reopen it.
gui.refinedstorage.interface.filter_help: The resources that should be pulled out of your system.
gui.refinedstorage.exporter.filter_help: The resources that should be pulled out of your system.
Only let resources that match the filters into your system.
Keep resources that match the filters out of your system.
gui.refinedstorage.priority.storage_help: The order your system puts things in and takes things out, highest first.
gui.refinedstorage.fuzzy_mode.on.extract: Match the filters when pulling from your system, ignoring components.
gui.refinedstorage.fuzzy_mode.off.extrac: Match the filters when pulling from your system exactly.
gui.refinedstorage.access_mode.insert_ex: Your system can put things in and take things out of this storage.
gui.refinedstorage.access_mode.insert.he: Your system can only put things into this storage. Whatever is inside will still show up in a Runic Console.
gui.refinedstorage.access_mode.extract.h: Your system can only take things out of this storage.
gui.refinedstorage.security_manager.reds: When this block is inactive, your system isn't protected.
gui.refinedstorage.security_manager.no_f: Put a Guest Bypass here to set what players without their own Ward Bypass are allowed to do. Without one, they can't do anything at all.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.filter_help: Resources that should be shared from the input side to the output side when the Relay isn't in pass-through mode.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.pass_through.he: Whether the Relay passes everything from the input side straight through. Turn this off to pick and choose what the output side gets.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.pass_energy.hel: Does nothing here: your system doesn't need power.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.pass_storage.he: Whether the output side can reach the input side's storage.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.pass_security.h: Whether the input side's Guardian Ward rules also apply on the output side.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.pass_autocrafti: Does nothing here: autocrafting isn't available.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.filter_mode.all: Only share resources that match the filters with the output side.
gui.refinedstorage.relay.filter_mode.blo: Don't share resources that match the filters with the output side.
gui.refinedstorage.disk_interface.filter: Only move resources that match the filters, in either direction.
Never move resources that match the filters, in either direction.
The resources that may or may not be moved in or out of the Glyphstones, depending on allowlist or blocklist mode.
gui.refinedstorage.disk_interface.transf: Moves everything from the Glyphstones into your system.
Moves things from your system into the Glyphstones.
item.refinedstorage.disk_drive.help: Holds up to 8 Glyphstones and adds their space to your system.
item.refinedstorage.disk_interface.help: Moves items between your system and the Glyphstones you put in it. Finished Glyphstones pop over to the Out slots.
item.refinedstorage.grid.help: Lets you see, add and take anything stored in your system.
item.refinedstorage.crafting_grid.help: A Runic Console with a crafting grid, which pulls ingredients straight from your system.
item.refinedstorage.importer.help: Pulls resources out of the block it faces and into your system.
item.refinedstorage.exporter.help: Pushes resources from your system into the block it faces.
item.refinedstorage.interface.help: Imports and exports through its own slots. Other blocks have to put things in and take things out of it themselves.
item.refinedstorage.external_storage.hel: Adds the block it faces (a chest, barrel, drawer...) to your system's storage.
item.refinedstorage.relay.help: Turns whole sections of your system on or off with redstone, or splits off a new branch.
item.refinedstorage.storage_disk.help: Stores %s items. When empty, use it while holding to get its Storage Glyph back. Combine it with a higher Storage Glyph to upgrade it.
item.refinedstorage.speed_upgrade.help: Makes the block it's in work faster.
item.refinedstorage.stack_upgrade.help: Makes the block it's in move a whole stack at a time.
item.refinedstorage.regulator_upgrade.he: In an Exporter, only exports until the target has the amount you set. In an Importer, only imports while the target has more than the amount you set. Use the item to set it up.
item.refinedstorage.range_upgrade.help: Adds 8 blocks to a Resonating Beacon's range.
item.refinedstorage.creative_range_upgra: Gives a Resonating Beacon infinite range. Doesn't reach other dimensions.
item.refinedstorage.wireless_transmitter: Lets Resonating items like the Resonating Console reach your system from within range. Place a few for wider coverage, or add Range Upgrades.
item.refinedstorage.network_item.unbound: Shift + right click any block in your system to bind it.
item.refinedstorage.configuration_card.e: Shift + right click a block in your system to copy its settings and upgrades.
item.refinedstorage.configuration_card.c: Shift + right click another block of the same kind to paste the settings and upgrades. Shift + right click the air to clear it.
This Mimic Glyph only works on %s.
item.refinedstorage.network_card.unbound: Shift + right click an Aetheric Receptor to attune it.
item.refinedstorage.network_card.bound_h: Put it in an Aetheric Messenger. Shift + right click the air to clear it.
Sends your system to an Aetheric Receptor anywhere, even in another dimension. Needs an Aetheric Attuner attuned to that Receptor.
item.refinedstorage.network_receiver.hel: Receives your system from an Aetheric Messenger. Attune an Aetheric Attuner to this block.
item.refinedstorage.cable.help: Connects the blocks in your system. Full blocks connect to any color. Cables only connect to the same color, or to the default gray.
item.refinedstorage.security_card.unboun: Right click to set permissions and bind it to yourself.
Right click to set permissions. Shift + right click to wipe it clean.
item.refinedstorage.fallback_security_ca: Sets what everyone without their own Ward Bypass can do. Right click to set permissions. Shift + right click to wipe it clean.
key.refinedstorage.clear_crafting_grid_m: Clear Crafting Console grid to system
Clear Crafting Console grid to inventory
permission.refinedstorage.insert.descrip: Whether the player can put things into the system.
permission.refinedstorage.extract.descri: Whether the player can take things out of the system.
permission.refinedstorage.autocrafting.d: Does nothing here: autocrafting isn't available.
permission.refinedstorage.open.descripti: Whether the player can open the system's blocks.
permission.refinedstorage.build.descript: Whether the player can add or remove blocks in the system.
permission.refinedstorage.security.descr: Whether the player can change the Guardian Ward's settings.
advancements.refinedstorage.root.descrip: Craft some Illuminite and begin your Magitech storage system
advancements.refinedstorage.connecting.d: Use Cable to connect your blocks, or just place them against each other
advancements.refinedstorage.drives.descr: Craft a Glyphic Repository to hold your Glyphstones
advancements.refinedstorage.interfacing_: Craft a Stone Manipulator to move things between your system and Glyphstones
advancements.refinedstorage.storing_item: Craft a Glyphstone and put it in your Glyphic Repository
advancements.refinedstorage.viewing_your: Craft a Runic Console to see what's in your system
advancements.refinedstorage.upgrading_yo: Upgrade your Runic Console to a Crafting Runic Console so you can craft right from your Console
advancements.refinedstorage.importing.de: Get things into your system with an Importer
advancements.refinedstorage.exporting.de: Get things out of your system with an Exporter
advancements.refinedstorage.upgrading.de: Craft an Upgrade to improve your blocks
advancements.refinedstorage.interface_to: Import and export at the same time with a Glyphic Liaison
advancements.refinedstorage.storing_exte: Use an External Storage to add a chest, barrel or drawer to your system
advancements.refinedstorage.wireless.des: Reach your system from afar with a Resonating Console and a Resonating Beacon
advancements.refinedstorage.no_cables_re: Connect a far-off storage to your system with an Aetheric Messenger, Aetheric Receptor and Aetheric Attuner
advancements.refinedstorage.security.des: Protect your system with a Guardian Ward and a Ward Bypass
advancements.refinedstorage.conditional_: Turn sections of your system on or off, or split off a new branch, with a Relay
